name: dsh-skills
description: Skills manager for DeepSeek Harness: a Skills panel in the left navigation that lists every installed Agent Skill, previews its instructions, enables or disables it without deleting it, installs skills from a folder or in batches from GitHub, and restores what was uninstalled.
